argumentDescriptions.ActivateObjects.objects[].type: Object type, either case: an ADT type code, or a name standing for one (in brackets after it): CLAS/OC (class), INTF/OI (interface), PROG/P (program), PROG/I (include), FUGR/F (functiongroup), FUGR/FF (function, functionmodule, function_module, func), FUGR/I, DEVC/K (package), DDLS/DF (view), TABL/DT (table), TABL/DS (structure, stru), TTYP/DA, DOMA/DD (domain), DTEL/DE (dataelement), DCLS/DL, BDEF/BDO, DDLX/EX, SRVD/SRV, SRVB/SVB, DSFD/SCF, DSFI/SFI, XSLT/VT, FTG2/FT, AUTH, ENHO/XHH, ENHO/XHB, ENHS/XSB. argumentDescriptions.ActivateObjects.preaudit: Request pre-audit before activation. Default: true. descriptions.ActivateObjects: Activates the repository objects named by objects (each a name and a type) together, in one activation: any object type, related objects such as domains, data elements and tables at once.
descriptions.GetIncludesList: [read-only] Recursively discover and list ALL include files within an ABAP program or include. Takes object_name and object_type (one object: its tree) or objects (several objects: one entry per object, in the order given, each { object_name, object_type, tree } or { object_name, object_type, error }). Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on.
descriptions.GetObjectVersionDiff: [read-only] Compares the two object versions named by content_uri_from and content_uri_to, entries of an object's version history, for the object type named by object_type: returns the unified diff (jsdiff) of their sources.
descriptions.GetObjectVersions: [read-only] Lists the version history of the class, program, interface, function module, table, structure, CDS view, behavior definition or metadata extension named by object_name and object_type. Returns each version with its versionId, author, updatedAt, title, the transportRequest (and transportDescription) that produced it when available, and the opaque content_uri that names the version's source.
descriptions.GetObjectVersionSource: [read-only] Reads the source code of the object version named by content_uri, an entry of an object's version history, for the object type named by object_type.
descriptions.GetWhereUsed: [read-only] Lists where the object named by object_name and object_type is used, for every type object_type takes, a function module (BAPI included) too: every object that uses, calls or references it, with its type and package. Takes object_name and object_type (one object: its list) or objects (several objects: one entry per object, in the order given, each its list or { object_name, object_type, error }). Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on.

descriptions.HandlerActivate: Activates the object named by object_name and object_type (or object_adt_type), or the objects named by objects, in one request. Single form (object_name*, object_type or object_adt_type*): object_type is enough for CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, METADATA_EXTENSION, PACKAGE, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING and BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION; FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name* as GROUP|MODULE, or object_name* with function_group_name*) is activated under its function group; any other type takes object_adt_type (e.g. "CLAS/OC"). List form (objects[].name*, objects[].type*, objects[].parentName, objects[].uri); a function module is listed with objects[].parentName set to its function group, type FUGR/FF. One object of CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, METADATA_EXTENSION or BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION (by object_type or its ADT type code) is activated directly and answers the activation verdict. Every other call starts an activation run and answers { run_id }: the id of the accepted run, whose status and messages are read by that id.
descriptions.HandlerCheckRun: [read-only] Runs a syntax check on the object named by object_type and object_name. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*), PROGRAM(object_name*), INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name* as GROUP|MODULE), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*). source_code checks unsaved source given in the call, for CLASS, STRUCTURE and DDL.
descriptions.HandlerCreate: Creates the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …): sends the create request for its type with the given parameters, and answers SAP's result. The object is created inactive. object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*, super_package*), DOMAIN(domain_name*, package_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*, package_name*), TRANSPORT(description*), TABLE(table_name*, package_name*), STRUCTURE(structure_name*, package_name*), DDL(ddl_name*, package_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*, package_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*, service_definition_name*, package_name*), CLASS(class_name*, package_name*), PROGRAM(program_name*, package_name*), INTERFACE(interface_name*, package_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*, package_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name*, function_group_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(name*, package_name*, implementation_type*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(class_name*, package_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(name*, package_name*). Optional for every type: description, transport_request.
descriptions.HandlerDelete: Deletes the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …): sends the deletion request for its type, and answers SAP's result. object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*, transport_request), DOMAIN(domain_name*, transport_request), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*, transport_request), TABLE(table_name*, transport_request), STRUCTURE(structure_name*, transport_request), DDL(ddl_name*, transport_request), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*, transport_request), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*, transport_request), CLASS(class_name*, transport_request), CDS_UNIT_TEST(class_name*, transport_request), PROGRAM(program_name*, transport_request), INTERFACE(interface_name*, transport_request), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*, transport_request), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name*, function_group_name*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(behavior_definition_name*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(behavior_implementation_name*, transport_request), METADATA_EXTENSION(metadata_extension_name*, transport_request), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), UNIT_TEST(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request). CDS_UNIT_TEST deletes its test class. For LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS and LOCAL_MACROS (the class's local includes) and UNIT_TEST (its test classes include) the include is written empty under lock_handle, the class's lock handle. transport_request is sent with the request. Over Streamable HTTP an include write takes the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header); it is sent only under a lock the instance it reaches holds.
descriptions.HandlerDeletionCheck: [read-only] Asks SAP whether the object named by object_type and object_name can be deleted: sends the deletion check request for its type, and answers SAP's verdict as it came: deletable true with the object and SAP's message when it carries one, or SAP's refusal with its words. object_type and object_name required: PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, CDS_UNIT_TEST (its test class), PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE (object_name GROUP|MODULE), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION.
descriptions.HandlerGet: [read-only] Reads one part of the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …). part selects it: source (default) the source alone, in one request; metadata the ADT metadata document alone, in one request; urls (SERVICE_BINDING) the service URL, its $metadata and the browser preview, contents (PACKAGE) the objects the package holds, its walk read level by level in ADT batch envelopes; package_names lists several packages, read together, one entry per package in the order given. A source document answers { part: 'source', source } and a metadata document { part: 'metadata', metadata }, beside the object's name. Parts per type: PACKAGE metadata, contents; DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, FUNCTION_GROUP metadata; LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, TRANSPORT, UNIT_TEST, CDS_UNIT_TEST source; SERVICE_BINDING source, metadata, urls; every other type source, metadata. A part outside the type's list is answered with that list. Three parts read the repository by ADT address: object_structure(object_adt_type*, object_name*), node_structure(object_adt_type*, object_name*, node_id, with_short_descriptions; one node level; a package's blank answer is the empty listing with blank stating its two readings: an empty package, or an unknown package name) and virtual_folders(object_search_pattern, preselection, facet_order, with_versions, ignore_short_descriptions). Two parts read an activation run by its id, in one request each: activation_status(run_id*) answers { run_id, part, status, document }, the run's status (finished, error, failed, or its progress while it runs) and its status document as SAP answered it; activation_results(run_id*) answers { run_id, part, messages, document }, the messages the run produced and its results document as SAP answered it. Otherwise object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*; part contents: package_name* or package_names*), DOMAIN(domain_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*), TABLE(table_name*), STRUCTURE(structure_name*), DDL(ddl_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*), CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*), PROGRAM(program_name*), INTERFACE(interface_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name* as GROUP|MODULE, or function_module_name* with function_group_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(behavior_definition_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(behavior_implementation_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(metadata_extension_name*), UNIT_TEST(run_id*), CDS_UNIT_TEST(run_id*), TRANSPORT(transport_number*). TRANSPORT answers the objects a task holds, each with its position in the task's object list; for a request, every task's entries, each once, with its task number and position. UNIT_TEST and CDS_UNIT_TEST read the run's result in one request and answer { success, run_id, run_result }, run_result the result document SAP answered, parsed. Valid once the status is FINISHED; a finished run's result carries executionTime. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on.
descriptions.HandlerLock: Lock operation. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*), PROGRAM(object_name*), INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name*), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*, super_package*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(object_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(object_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(object_name*). Answers the lock_handle; a SERVICE_BINDING open in an editing session answers an empty one, under which its publication runs. Over Streamable HTTP the answer also carries the state_handle of the instance that holds the lock: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under this lock, the write and the unlock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header).
descriptions.HandlerProfileRun: [read-only] Runs a class or a program in one request. Required: target_type*(CLASS|PROGRAM) + class_name* for CLASS or program_name* for PROGRAM. Optional: profiler_id (the profiler id of a scheduled trace; given, the run goes under that trace; absent, the run is plain), background. Response: JSON { success, class_name | program_name, output }, plus profile: { profiler_id } for a run under a trace.
descriptions.HandlerUnlock: Unlock operation. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*, lock_handle*), PROGRAM(object_name*, lock_handle*), INTERFACE(object_name*, lock_handle*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*, lock_handle*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name*, lock_handle*), TABLE(object_name*, lock_handle*), STRUCTURE(object_name*, lock_handle*), DDL(object_name*, lock_handle*), DOMAIN(object_name*, lock_handle*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*, lock_handle*), PACKAGE(object_name*, lock_handle*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*, lock_handle*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(object_name*, lock_handle*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*, lock_handle*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(object_name*, lock_handle*), SERVICE_BINDING(object_name*, lock_handle*); an empty lock_handle of a SERVICE_BINDING answers that the binding is already unlocked. Over Streamable HTTP the unlock takes the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header); the unlock ends the instance's hold on the lock.
descriptions.HandlerUpdate: Writes the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …) under its lock: sends the one write request of its type under lock_handle, the lock handle of the object, and answers SAP's result. The write sets the whole content to the one given. lock_handle and object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*, source_code*, transport_request), DOMAIN(domain_name*, source_code*, transport_request), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*, source_code*, transport_request), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*, source_code*, transport_request), TABLE(table_name*, ddl_code*, transport_request), STRUCTURE(structure_name*, ddl_code*, transport_request), DDL(ddl_name*, ddl_source*, transport_request), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*, source_code*, transport_request), CLASS(class_name*, source_code*, transport_request), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*, test_class_code*, transport_request), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*, local_types_code*, transport_request), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*, definitions_code*, transport_request), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*, macros_code*, transport_request), UNIT_TEST(class_name*, test_class_source*, transport_request), CDS_UNIT_TEST(class_name*, test_class_source*, transport_request), PROGRAM(program_name*, source_code*, transport_request), INTERFACE(interface_name*, source_code*, transport_request), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name*, function_group_name*, source_code*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(name*, source_code*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(class_name*, implementation_code*, transport_request), METADATA_EXTENSION(name*, source_code*, transport_request), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*, desired_publication_state*, binding_variant*, service_name, service_version). For PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT and FUNCTION_GROUP, source_code is the whole metadata document, sent as given. For LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, UNIT_TEST, CDS_UNIT_TEST and BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, lock_handle is the class's lock handle. For SERVICE_BINDING the write is its publication request, sent under the lock_handle given, an empty one included; service_name and service_version (default 0001) name the service of an OData V2 binding. transport_request is sent as the write's corrNr. Over Streamable HTTP the write takes the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header); the write is sent only under a lock the instance it reaches holds.
descriptions.HandlerValidate: [read-only] Validates a new object named by object_type and object_name before it is created. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*, superclass), PROGRAM(object_name*), INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name* as GROUP|MODULE), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*, super_package), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*, package_name*, description*, root_entity*, implementation_type*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(object_name*, package_name*, behavior_definition), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*, description*, package_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(object_name*=service_binding_name*, service_definition_name*, package_name*).
descriptions.HandlerWhereUsed: [read-only] Lists where the object named by object_type and object_name is used — a class, interface, program, include, function group, function module (BAPI included), package, table, structure, domain, data element or CDS DDL source: the objects that use, call or reference it, with type and package. Required: object_type*, object_name*. Optional: function_group_name (FUNCTION_MODULE), max_results (default 100). Response: JSON. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on.

descriptions.HandlerCheckRun: [read-only] Runs a syntax check on the object named by object_type and object_name. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*), PROGRAM(object_name*), INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name* as GROUP|MODULE), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*). source_code checks unsaved source given in the call, for CLASS, STRUCTURE and DDL.
descriptions.HandlerDeletionCheck: [read-only] Asks SAP whether the object named by object_type and object_name can be deleted: sends the deletion check request for its type, and answers SAP's verdict as it came: deletable true with the object and SAP's message when it carries one, or SAP's refusal with its words. object_type and object_name required: PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, CDS_UNIT_TEST (its test class), PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE (object_name GROUP|MODULE), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION.
descriptions.HandlerGet: [read-only] Reads one part of the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …). part selects it: source (default) the source alone, in one request; metadata the ADT metadata document alone, in one request; urls (SERVICE_BINDING) the service URL, its $metadata and the browser preview, contents (PACKAGE) the objects the package holds, its walk read level by level in ADT batch envelopes; package_names lists several packages, read together, one entry per package in the order given. A source document answers { part: 'source', source } and a metadata document { part: 'metadata', metadata }, beside the object's name. Parts per type: PACKAGE metadata, contents; DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, FUNCTION_GROUP metadata; LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, TRANSPORT, UNIT_TEST, CDS_UNIT_TEST source; SERVICE_BINDING source, metadata, urls; every other type source, metadata. A part outside the type's list is answered with that list. Three parts read the repository by ADT address: object_structure(object_adt_type*, object_name*), node_structure(object_adt_type*, object_name*, node_id, with_short_descriptions; one node level; a package's blank answer is the empty listing with blank stating its two readings: an empty package, or an unknown package name) and virtual_folders(object_search_pattern, preselection, facet_order, with_versions, ignore_short_descriptions). Two parts read an activation run by its id, in one request each: activation_status(run_id*) answers { run_id, part, status, document }, the run's status (finished, error, failed, or its progress while it runs) and its status document as SAP answered it; activation_results(run_id*) answers { run_id, part, messages, document }, the messages the run produced and its results document as SAP answered it. Otherwise object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*; part contents: package_name* or package_names*), DOMAIN(domain_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*), TABLE(table_name*), STRUCTURE(structure_name*), DDL(ddl_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*), CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*), PROGRAM(program_name*), INTERFACE(interface_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name* as GROUP|MODULE, or function_module_name* with function_group_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(behavior_definition_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(behavior_implementation_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(metadata_extension_name*), UNIT_TEST(run_id*), CDS_UNIT_TEST(run_id*), TRANSPORT(transport_number*). TRANSPORT answers the objects a task holds, each with its position in the task's object list; for a request, every task's entries, each once, with its task number and position. UNIT_TEST and CDS_UNIT_TEST read the run's result in one request and answer { success, run_id, run_result }, run_result the result document SAP answered, parsed. Valid once the status is FINISHED; a finished run's result carries executionTime. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on.
descriptions.HandlerValidate: [read-only] Validates a new object named by object_type and object_name before it is created. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*, superclass), PROGRAM(object_name*), INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name* as GROUP|MODULE), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*, super_package), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*, package_name*, description*, root_entity*, implementation_type*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(object_name*, package_name*, behavior_definition), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*, description*, package_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(object_name*=service_binding_name*, service_definition_name*, package_name*).
descriptions.HandlerWhereUsed: [read-only] Lists where the object named by object_type and object_name is used — a class, interface, program, include, function group, function module (BAPI included), package, table, structure, domain, data element or CDS DDL source: the objects that use, call or reference it, with type and package. Required: object_type*, object_name*. Optional: function_group_name (FUNCTION_MODULE), max_results (default 100). Response: JSON. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on.

argumentDescriptions.ActivateObjects.objects[].type: Object type, either case: an ADT type code, or a name standing for one (in brackets after it): CLAS/OC (class), INTF/OI (interface), FUGR/F (functiongroup), FUGR/FF (function, functionmodule, function_module, func), FUGR/I, DEVC/K (package), DDLS/DF (view), TABL/DT (table), TABL/DS (structure, stru), TTYP/DA, DOMA/DD (domain), DTEL/DE (dataelement), DCLS/DL, BDEF/BDO, DDLX/EX, SRVD/SRV, SRVB/SVB, DSFD/SCF, DSFI/SFI, XSLT/VT, AUTH, ENHO/XHH, ENHO/XHB, ENHS/XSB. One object alone may also be named function_group, ddl, data_element, behavior_definition, metadata_extension. A main type, the part of a code before its slash, stands for its code when exactly one listed code has it.
argumentDescriptions.ActivateObjects.preaudit: Request pre-audit before activation. Default: true. Sent as preauditRequested when the call takes group activation: more than one object, or one object of any other type. These types (case-insensitive) take single-object activation: CLAS/OC, INTF/OI, FUGR/F, TABL/DT, TABL/DS, DDLS/DF, DOMA/DD, DTEL/DE, BDEF/BDO, DDLX/EX, function_group, ddl, data_element, behavior_definition, metadata_extension, class, functiongroup, interface, table, structure, domain, dataelement, view, stru. So does a main type standing for one of these codes. Their family's activate() always sends preauditRequested=true.

descriptions.ActivateObjects: Activates the repository objects named by objects (each a name and a type) together, in one activation: any object type, related objects such as domains, data elements and tables at once.
descriptions.GetIncludesList: [read-only] Recursively discover and list ALL include files within an ABAP program or include. Takes object_name and object_type (one object: its tree) or objects (several objects: one entry per object, in the order given, each { object_name, object_type, tree } or { object_name, object_type, error }). Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on.
descriptions.GetObjectVersionDiff: [read-only] Compares the two object versions named by content_uri_from and content_uri_to, entries of an object's version history, for the object type named by object_type: returns the unified diff (jsdiff) of their sources.
descriptions.GetObjectVersions: [read-only] Lists the version history of the class, program, interface, function module, table, structure, CDS view, behavior definition or metadata extension named by object_name and object_type. Returns each version with its versionId, author, updatedAt, title, the transportRequest (and transportDescription) that produced it when available, and the opaque content_uri that names the version's source.
descriptions.GetObjectVersionSource: [read-only] Reads the source code of the object version named by content_uri, an entry of an object's version history, for the object type named by object_type.
descriptions.GetWhereUsed: [read-only] Lists where the object named by object_name and object_type is used, for every type object_type takes, a function module (BAPI included) too: every object that uses, calls or references it, with its type and package. Takes object_name and object_type (one object: its list) or objects (several objects: one entry per object, in the order given, each its list or { object_name, object_type, error }). Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on.

descriptions.HandlerActivate: Activates the object named by object_name and object_type (or object_adt_type), or the objects named by objects, in one request. Single form (object_name*, object_type or object_adt_type*): object_type is enough for CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, METADATA_EXTENSION, PACKAGE, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING and BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION; FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name* as GROUP|MODULE, or object_name* with function_group_name*) is activated under its function group; any other type takes object_adt_type (e.g. "CLAS/OC"). List form (objects[].name*, objects[].type*, objects[].parentName, objects[].uri); a function module is listed with objects[].parentName set to its function group, type FUGR/FF. One object of CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, METADATA_EXTENSION or BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION (by object_type or its ADT type code) is activated directly and answers the activation verdict. Every other call starts an activation run and answers { run_id }: the id of the accepted run, whose status and messages are read by that id.
descriptions.HandlerCheckRun: [read-only] Runs a syntax check on the object named by object_type and object_name. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*), PROGRAM(object_name*), INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name* as GROUP|MODULE), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*). source_code checks unsaved source given in the call, for CLASS, STRUCTURE and DDL.
descriptions.HandlerCreate: Creates the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …): sends the create request for its type with the given parameters, and answers SAP's result. The object is created inactive. object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*, super_package*), DOMAIN(domain_name*, package_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*, package_name*), TRANSPORT(description*), TABLE(table_name*, package_name*), STRUCTURE(structure_name*, package_name*), DDL(ddl_name*, package_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*, package_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*, service_definition_name*, package_name*), CLASS(class_name*, package_name*), PROGRAM(program_name*, package_name*), INTERFACE(interface_name*, package_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*, package_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name*, function_group_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(name*, package_name*, implementation_type*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(class_name*, package_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(name*, package_name*). Optional for every type: description, transport_request.
descriptions.HandlerDelete: Deletes the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …): sends the deletion request for its type, and answers SAP's result. object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*, transport_request), DOMAIN(domain_name*, transport_request), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*, transport_request), TABLE(table_name*, transport_request), STRUCTURE(structure_name*, transport_request), DDL(ddl_name*, transport_request), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*, transport_request), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*, transport_request), CLASS(class_name*, transport_request), CDS_UNIT_TEST(class_name*, transport_request), PROGRAM(program_name*, transport_request), INTERFACE(interface_name*, transport_request), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*, transport_request), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name*, function_group_name*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(behavior_definition_name*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(behavior_implementation_name*, transport_request), METADATA_EXTENSION(metadata_extension_name*, transport_request), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), UNIT_TEST(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request). CDS_UNIT_TEST deletes its test class. For LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS and LOCAL_MACROS (the class's local includes) and UNIT_TEST (its test classes include) the include is written empty under lock_handle, the class's lock handle. transport_request is sent with the request. Over Streamable HTTP an include write takes the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header); it is sent only under a lock the instance it reaches holds.

descriptions.HandlerLock: Lock operation. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*), PROGRAM(object_name*), INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name*), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*, super_package*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(object_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(object_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(object_name*). Answers the lock_handle; a SERVICE_BINDING open in an editing session answers an empty one, under which its publication runs. Over Streamable HTTP the answer also carries the state_handle of the instance that holds the lock: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under this lock, the write and the unlock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header).
descriptions.HandlerProfileRun: [read-only] Runs a class or a program in one request. Required: target_type*(CLASS|PROGRAM) + class_name* for CLASS or program_name* for PROGRAM. Optional: profiler_id (the profiler id of a scheduled trace; given, the run goes under that trace; absent, the run is plain), background. Response: JSON { success, class_name | program_name, output }, plus profile: { profiler_id } for a run under a trace.
descriptions.HandlerUnlock: Unlock operation. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*, lock_handle*), PROGRAM(object_name*, lock_handle*), INTERFACE(object_name*, lock_handle*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*, lock_handle*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name*, lock_handle*), TABLE(object_name*, lock_handle*), STRUCTURE(object_name*, lock_handle*), DDL(object_name*, lock_handle*), DOMAIN(object_name*, lock_handle*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*, lock_handle*), PACKAGE(object_name*, lock_handle*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*, lock_handle*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(object_name*, lock_handle*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*, lock_handle*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(object_name*, lock_handle*), SERVICE_BINDING(object_name*, lock_handle*); an empty lock_handle of a SERVICE_BINDING answers that the binding is already unlocked. Over Streamable HTTP the unlock takes the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header); the unlock ends the instance's hold on the lock.
descriptions.HandlerUpdate: Writes the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …) under its lock: sends the one write request of its type under lock_handle, the lock handle of the object, and answers SAP's result. The write sets the whole content to the one given. lock_handle and object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*, source_code*, transport_request), DOMAIN(domain_name*, source_code*, transport_request), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*, source_code*, transport_request), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*, source_code*, transport_request), TABLE(table_name*, ddl_code*, transport_request), STRUCTURE(structure_name*, ddl_code*, transport_request), DDL(ddl_name*, ddl_source*, transport_request), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*, source_code*, transport_request), CLASS(class_name*, source_code*, transport_request), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*, test_class_code*, transport_request), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*, local_types_code*, transport_request), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*, definitions_code*, transport_request), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*, macros_code*, transport_request), UNIT_TEST(class_name*, test_class_source*, transport_request), CDS_UNIT_TEST(class_name*, test_class_source*, transport_request), PROGRAM(program_name*, source_code*, transport_request), INTERFACE(interface_name*, source_code*, transport_request), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name*, function_group_name*, source_code*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(name*, source_code*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(class_name*, implementation_code*, transport_request), METADATA_EXTENSION(name*, source_code*, transport_request), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*, desired_publication_state*, binding_variant*, service_name, service_version). For PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT and FUNCTION_GROUP, source_code is the whole metadata document, sent as given. For LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, UNIT_TEST, CDS_UNIT_TEST and BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, lock_handle is the class's lock handle. For SERVICE_BINDING the write is its publication request, sent under the lock_handle given, an empty one included; service_name and service_version (default 0001) name the service of an OData V2 binding. transport_request is sent as the write's corrNr. Over Streamable HTTP the write takes the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header); the write is sent only under a lock the instance it reaches holds.
descriptions.HandlerValidate: [read-only] Validates a new object named by object_type and object_name before it is created. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*, superclass), PROGRAM(object_name*), INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name* as GROUP|MODULE), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*, super_package), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*, package_name*, description*, root_entity*, implementation_type*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(object_name*, package_name*, behavior_definition), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*, description*, package_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(object_name*=service_binding_name*, service_definition_name*, package_name*).
descriptions.HandlerWhereUsed: [read-only] Lists where the object named by object_type and object_name is used — a class, interface, program, include, function group, function module (BAPI included), package, table, structure, domain, data element or CDS DDL source: the objects that use, call or reference it, with type and package. Required: object_type*, object_name*. Optional: function_group_name (FUNCTION_MODULE), max_results (default 100). Response: JSON. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on.

descriptions.HandlerCheckRun: [read-only] Runs a syntax check on the object named by object_type and object_name. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*), PROGRAM(object_name*), INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name* as GROUP|MODULE), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*). source_code checks unsaved source given in the call, for CLASS, STRUCTURE and DDL.
descriptions.HandlerDeletionCheck: [read-only] Asks SAP whether the object named by object_type and object_name can be deleted: sends the deletion check request for its type, and answers SAP's verdict as it came: deletable true with the object and SAP's message when it carries one, or SAP's refusal with its words. object_type and object_name required: PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, CDS_UNIT_TEST (its test class), PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE (object_name GROUP|MODULE), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION.
descriptions.HandlerGet: [read-only] Reads one part of the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …). part selects it: source (default) the source alone, in one request; metadata the ADT metadata document alone, in one request; urls (SERVICE_BINDING) the service URL, its $metadata and the browser preview, contents (PACKAGE) the objects the package holds, its walk read level by level in ADT batch envelopes; package_names lists several packages, read together, one entry per package in the order given. A source document answers { part: 'source', source } and a metadata document { part: 'metadata', metadata }, beside the object's name. Parts per type: PACKAGE metadata, contents; DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, FUNCTION_GROUP metadata; LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, TRANSPORT, UNIT_TEST, CDS_UNIT_TEST source; SERVICE_BINDING source, metadata, urls; every other type source, metadata. A part outside the type's list is answered with that list. Three parts read the repository by ADT address: object_structure(object_adt_type*, object_name*), node_structure(object_adt_type*, object_name*, node_id, with_short_descriptions; one node level; a package's blank answer is the empty listing with blank stating its two readings: an empty package, or an unknown package name) and virtual_folders(object_search_pattern, preselection, facet_order, with_versions, ignore_short_descriptions). Two parts read an activation run by its id, in one request each: activation_status(run_id*) answers { run_id, part, status, document }, the run's status (finished, error, failed, or its progress while it runs) and its status document as SAP answered it; activation_results(run_id*) answers { run_id, part, messages, document }, the messages the run produced and its results document as SAP answered it. Otherwise object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*; part contents: package_name* or package_names*), DOMAIN(domain_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*), TABLE(table_name*), STRUCTURE(structure_name*), DDL(ddl_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*), CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*), PROGRAM(program_name*), INTERFACE(interface_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name* as GROUP|MODULE, or function_module_name* with function_group_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(behavior_definition_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(behavior_implementation_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(metadata_extension_name*), UNIT_TEST(run_id*), CDS_UNIT_TEST(run_id*), TRANSPORT(transport_number*). TRANSPORT answers the objects a task holds, each with its position in the task's object list; for a request, every task's entries, each once, with its task number and position. UNIT_TEST and CDS_UNIT_TEST read the run's result in one request and answer { success, run_id, run_result }, run_result the result document SAP answered, parsed. Valid once the status is FINISHED; a finished run's result carries executionTime. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on.
